mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT equip_name FROM quality_temp_uniform WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND equip_name != '' ORDER BY equip_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quality_temp_uniform (equip_name, survey_date, set_temp, max_temp, min_temp, tolerance, deviation, judgment, inspector, remark, reg_user_name) VALUES (#{equipName}, #{surveyDate}, #{setTemp}, #{maxTemp}, #{minTemp}, #{tolerance}, #{deviation}, #{judgment}, #{inspector}, #{remark}, #{regUserName})
mapper.update: UPDATE quality_temp_uniform SET equip_name = #{equipName}, survey_date = #{surveyDate}, set_temp = #{setTemp}, max_temp = #{maxTemp}, min_temp = #{minTemp}, tolerance = #{tolerance}, deviation = #{deviation}, judgment = #{judgment}, inspector = #{inspector}, remark = #{remark}, upd_dt = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE quality_temp_uniform SET use_yn = 'N', upd_dt = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
